capabilities: Display word, page, character, note, line, link and embed counts in the File Explorer
Show reading time, created/updated dates, file size, aliases and frontmatter keys per file
Set per-note word goals and show percent-of-goal progress
Exclude notes, comments, or code blocks from counts
Configure count methods, alignment, abbreviations and formatting
disambiguation: Despite the name, it works on any vault; nothing limits it to fiction or novel-writing projects.
extras: The README warns the plugin uses undocumented duck typing to access the File Explorer pane, so major Obsidian updates could temporarily break it; it also states the vault is treated as read-only and no data is transmitted over the Internet.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count only covers the current note in the editor, so there is no per-file or per-folder statistics view in the File Explorer.

relations.evidence: For an expanded version of Obsidian's built-in Word Count feature, which shows data for the current note in the Editor pane, check out Better Word Count
For more features and improved graphic design around word goals, check out Writing Goals by @lynchjames.

summary: File explorer plugin that displays word, page and character counts, reading time, dates and other statistics next to each file, folder and the vault.
